objective: Estimate seed-level uncertainty across the complete four-allocation, Random and ShareGPT offered-load grid, then construct a non-fixture schema-v2 selector profile from hash-verified capacity and serving evidence.
hypothesis: All four orthogonal precision allocations remain executable across the complete calibration grid, and three independent seed/trace repeats provide finite pointwise robust bounds for SLO-goodput, P95 TTFT, and P95 TPOT without missing or silently excluded samples.
dependent_variables: goodput_req_s across the predeclared TTFT thresholds
unit_of_analysis: one allocation-workload-rate-seed sample; seed/trace, not request, is the independent repeat for uncertainty
determinism_class: environment-sensitive serving benchmark with deterministic generation and seed-dependent request traces

gate_1_parent_evidence.scope: Four allocations completed the real-GPU end-to-end path once; this authorizes calibration but is not paper-level quantitative evidence.

code.run_revision_policy: The remote worktree must be clean at the Git commit containing this frozen contract and launcher. The exact commit is captured by attempt_contract.json and every sample contract.

preflight.matrix_proof: The tested config resolves calibration to exactly 144 samples and confirmatory seeds are disjoint.
preflight.gate_1: The parent MVEx completed 4/4 samples and 7200/7200 measurement requests with exact allocation-specific precision and PIECEWISE log proofs.

matrix.plan_canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':') and no trailing newline
matrix.sample_ids_canonicalization: Runner-order sample ID array as compact UTF-8 JSON with no trailing newline

statistical_plan.bounds: Two-sided 95% Student t interval across the three repeat-level metrics; the lower endpoint is used for SLO-goodput and the upper endpoint for P95 TTFT and P95 TPOT.
statistical_plan.request_level_pseudoreplication: Requests are used only to compute each repeat-level metric and are never treated as independent repeats.
statistical_plan.multiple_comparisons: This calibration performs no claim-level significance testing. Bounds are pointwise controller inputs; confirmatory comparisons and multiplicity correction are reserved for disjoint seeds 11, 23, and 47.
statistical_plan.exploratory_boundary: Calibration outcomes may choose a selector profile but may not be reported as confirmatory paper effects.

execution.estimated_compute_scope: Four sequential vLLM cold starts and 144 measurements of 60 seconds plus warmups; expected wall time approximately 4 to 6 hours with an eight-hour hard limit.

disk_policy.cache_and_temp_policy: Pip, Hugging Face, Transformers, Torch, Triton, CUDA, vLLM, TMPDIR, worktrees, logs, and results must resolve under /root/autodl-tmp.

expected_outputs: launch/<attempt_id>/pid, started_at, run.log, exit_code, and finished_at
<attempt_id>/samples/<sample_id>/contract.json, result.json, analysis.json, required sidecars, status.json, and bench.log
success_criteria: The launcher exits 0 and summary reports exactly completed_validated=144 with no failed, running, not_started, or silently excluded sample.
The observed canonical plan and sample-ID digests exactly match the frozen hashes, with 36 samples per allocation, 320400 measurement requests, and 17280 warmup requests.
All four allocation commands and logs prove the exact orthogonal KV and recurrent-state precision controls plus CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE; no tensor-parallel argument is present.

Every sample conserves its offered-rate times 60-second measurement denominator, counts failures as SLO misses, passes arrival-window and goodput cross-check gates, and emits finite repeat-level metrics.
Every required JSON SHA-256 sidecar matches, the ShareGPT and model identities match this contract, and attempt/sample provenance records one clean run revision.
Exactly three repeat-level observations exist for every allocation-workload-rate cell, allowing the predeclared pointwise t bounds to be computed without imputation or exclusion.
All servers remain healthy after each benchmark, stop after their allocation slice, port 8000 is free after exit, and both disks remain above safety thresholds.
failure_criteria: Any nonzero launcher or child exit, hard or sample timeout, OOM, server-health failure, or occupied output path invalidates this attempt.

Any missing sample, reduced request denominator, non-finite metric, failed arrival-window check, missing precision proof, hash mismatch, dirty root worktree, dataset drift, or provenance mismatch invalidates this attempt.
An invalid attempt is preserved and never resumed or retried under the same attempt ID; any retry requires a new frozen contract and a new ID linked through parent_attempt.
promotion_gate: Passing the complete Gate 2 audit authorizes hash-verified schema-v2 profile construction and disjoint-seed controller confirmatory execution. It does not promote calibration metrics to paper evidence.
evidence_policy: This calibration remains UNVERIFIED diagnostic evidence until completeness and statistical audits pass; even after analysis it remains non-confirmatory and excluded from paper-level effect estimates.
